svg.title: Rental Housing Law Navigator — proposed architecture
svg.desc: Code-rendered architecture, refined from the supplied handwritten sketch and participant guide.
svg.text: Eight logical entities: independent requirements, immutable evidence, and reproducible evaluations.
0..1 : N · case is optional on a run
Groups distinct obligations; applicability is computed per rule.
Unique(team_rule_id, version); one stable ID per requirement.
Junction: many rule versions can cite many source captures.
Retain captured text; retrieval time is separate from law dates.
Supports date, boundary, hypothetical and negative cases.
Summary retains affected IDs, conflict IDs and case notes.
One result per run / property / rule version / date / scenario.
Keep missing facts null and explain unresolved jurisdiction.
Each requirement has its own coverage, dates, evidence and result. Successive versions retain the same rule ID.
Logical model: SQL tables or versioned JSON records. Frontend accesses these records through the backend API.
Crow’s feet indicate many. PK = primary key; FK = foreign key. Shared data storage is owned by the backend team.
